fragments.text: Who should come: This is a builders-only AI Tinkerers event, and attendance is by application only. It is for engineers, technical founders, researchers, and designers who build and are ready to spend the day shipping a working prototype.

Global Sponsors: OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company whose mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. Its work spans frontier research and products that turn advanced AI capabilities into tools people and organizations can use. OpenAI is focused on making advanced intelligence safe, useful, accessible, and broadly beneficial—supporting greater productivity, creativity, scientific progress, and economic opportunity. CopilotKit CopilotKit is the Agentic Application Platform, an open-source framework and cloud platform for building and operating production-grade agentic applications. Its stack connects AI agents to user-facing products through in-app actions, generative UI, real-time context awareness, and support for protocols including AG-UI, MCP, and A2A. OpenRouter OpenRouter is an AI gateway and model marketplace offering a unified interface for hundreds of models across multiple providers. It is designed to reduce vendor lock-in while improving availability, pricing flexibility, and control over model routing. Many more global partners will be joining the event and added to this page soon.

fragments.text: Developer Infrastructure Partners: Exa Exa builds search infrastructure for AI applications. Its search engine and APIs help developers and agents find, retrieve, and synthesize high-quality web content through natural-language queries. Trigger.dev Trigger.dev is an open-source background jobs framework for building reliable workflows in plain async code. It provides infrastructure for long-running tasks and AI workloads, including queuing, retries, elastic scaling, and real-time monitoring. Auth0 Auth0 is an identity platform for developers, providing authentication and authorization infrastructure for web, mobile, and AI applications. Its SDKs and APIs help teams add secure login, access control, and identity workflows without building them from scratch. Mozilla Mozilla.ai builds open-source AI tools and infrastructure designed to make it easier for developers to create trustworthy, transparent, and controllable AI applications. Ambiguous AI Ambiguous is the workspace for human-AI collaboration. 17 productivity apps rebuilt from scratch to make work flow across Docs, Mail, Chat, Sheets, CRM, Calendar, and more. Each AI coworker has its own identity and works in the same apps and on the same data like the rest of the team. You can send it an email, message it in chat, assign it a task, or @mention it in a comment. Teams of up to five can use all 17 apps for free, and agents can get started through CLI or MCP in under a minute. Sep 12 Saturday Saturday, September 12th, 2026 • 10AM to 5PM (PDT) San Francisco Available after application approval

Hosted By: Julius Olsson Sahar Mor (Bond AI) BuilderBase Ayush Ojha Sean Chiu Tenki Cloud AI Featured in Bond AI - San Francisco and Bay Area AI Security Hackathon - By Hackathons.team 501 Folsom St San Francisco, CA

🔒 AI SECURITY HACKATHON — San Francisco: A one-day, in-person hackathon for builders exploring AI and security. Build an agent, break something responsibly, or create a tool that makes AI safer. Ideas are wide open—bring something worth showing. 👋 WHO SHOULD COME: Security researchers, agent builders, red-teamers, and anyone who ships. Come solo or in teams of 1–5. All experience levels welcome.

🔒 AI SECURITY HACKATHON — San Francisco: A one-day, in-person hackathon for builders exploring AI and security. Build an agent, break something responsibly, or create a tool that makes AI safer. Ideas are wide open—bring something worth showing.

🤝 SPONSORS & SPONSOR PRIZES: 🚀 WASMER Wasmer lets you run apps and code anywhere—from your laptop to the cloud to the browser—in a secure sandbox. The new Wasmer SDK gives AI agents a local sandbox for executing code, making it a natural fit for agentic security projects. Wasmer track — best projects built with the Wasmer SDK: 🥇 1st: $5,000 in Wasmer credits 🥈 2nd: $2,500 in Wasmer credits 🥉 3rd: $1,500 in Wasmer credits Hackathon offer: 3 months of Wasmer Pro free—a $1,500 value. Learn more · SDK documentation ☁️ TENKI CLOUD Winner’s prize: $10,000 in Tenki Cloud credits. Startup program: Eligible startups can access up to $50,000 in credits through Tenki Cloud’s startup program.

🏢 VENUE PARTNER — ENTREPRENEURS FIRST Entrepreneurs First (EF) turns exceptional individuals into funded founders. Some might have an early idea, others may need a cofounder. What matters is their potential. We back these founders first, then give them a bridge to Silicon Valley. To date, their companies are worth > $16B.

🗓 WHEN & WHERE: ⏱ Doors: 9:30 AM 🛠 Build: 10:00 AM–6:00 PM 🎤 Demos & judging: From 6:00 PM ⚖️ JUDGING: Working demo on a real, authorized target · technical depth · originality · shock factor · progress made on the day.
🗓 WHEN & WHERE: All times Pacific. In-person participation is preferred, but great remote teams are welcome. 👋 WHO SHOULD COME: Spots are limited. Register below.

fragments.text: What sponsors get: Your name and logo on the event page, on the day, and in the published results. A sponsor-defined challenge track with a prize in your name. Your product, API or credits as one of the tools people build with. A workshop or office-hours slot during the build. Opt-in introductions to participants who want to hear from you, and recruiting on the day. A short report afterwards: who took part, what was built on your product, and the results. What sponsorship does not include: Any say in who judges. Any access to judge applications, to submissions before the demos, to scorecards, or to who wins. Sponsor-defined tracks are judged by the same panel against the same published rubric: the sponsor sets the challenge, not the outcome. Your employees are welcome to apply to judge. They are assessed on exactly the same standard as everyone else, their affiliation is shown on the panel, and they recuse from any project built on your product or by anyone they work with. We do not publish packages. What a sponsorship looks like depends on the event and on what you bring; the enquiry is where that conversation starts.
